```{=typst}
// Quarto has no square papersize: set a 12 cm square page in raw Typst. The photo runs to the
// edges, so the page has no margin; the layout below keeps its own insets.
#set page(width: 12cm, height: 12cm, margin: 0cm, numbering: none, fill: rgb("#0b2545"))
#set text(fill: white)
#set par(justify: false)
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
import pandas as pd

attractions = pd.read_csv("data/attractions.csv")
top = attractions.loc[attractions["visits_2025"].idxmax()]
top_name = top["attraction"].split(" (")[0]
top_visits = f"{top['visits_2025']:,}"
entry = "Free to enter" if top["admission"].startswith("Free") else "Tickets needed"


def typst_string(text: str) -> str:
    """A Python string as a Typst string literal."""
    return '"' + text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"') + '"'


# Hand the computed facts to the Typst layout below, as Typst variables.
print("```{=typst}")
print(f"#let top-name = {typst_string(top_name)}")
print(f"#let top-visits = {typst_string(top_visits)}")
print(f"#let entry = {typst_string(entry)}")
print("```")
```

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#0b2545")

// The photo fills the square: fit "cover" crops the portrait photo to its middle, the tower
// from the spire down.
#place(top + left, image("images/big-ben.jpg", width: 12cm, height: 12cm, fit: "cover"))
// A light navy wash over the photo, then a navy gradient over its lower part, keep white text
// legible on sky and stone.
#place(top + left, rect(width: 12cm, height: 12cm, stroke: none, fill: navy.transparentize(82%)))
#place(top + left, dy: 5.2cm, rect(width: 12cm, height: 6.8cm, stroke: none,
  fill: gradient.linear((navy.transparentize(100%), 0%), (navy.transparentize(50%), 30%),
                        (navy.transparentize(5%), 100%), angle: 90deg)))
// The frame: a thin border inset from the edge, like a printed card.
#place(top + left, dx: 0.42cm, dy: 0.42cm,
  rect(width: 11.16cm, height: 11.16cm, radius: 0.3cm, stroke: 1.2pt + white.transparentize(15%)))

// A badge beside the attraction: the call to action.
#place(bottom + right, dx: -inset, dy: -1.3cm,
  box(fill: gold, radius: 1cm, inset: (x: 0.38cm, y: 0.2cm),
    text(fill: navy, size: 9pt, weight: "bold", entry)))
